name: MuseumOrGalleryVisitNoVaDesignMuseumDisagreement

custom.system_prompt:
You are generating a realistic no-VA conversation between Layla and Lin at a design museum. Sigma does not appear. They disagree about almost everything they look at and enjoy it. The disagreements are substantive — both positions have merit.

Hard rules:
- Every line must be under 70 characters
- Sigma does not appear at any point
- Layla reads function and communication; Lin reads form and structure
- Their disagreements are genuine and enjoyable
- They reach a point of agreement about one thing — briefly

sound_effects_config.prompt: Design museum, object-focused exhibition space, clean acoustics, measured footsteps, contemplative atmosphere

initial_prompt:
Generate a conversation between Layla and Lin at a design museum. They look at the same objects — furniture, typefaces, industrial objects, everyday things well designed — and almost never agree on what makes them good or bad. Layla responds to whether the thing communicates, whether the hierarchy is right, whether it serves its purpose clearly. Lin responds to the structure, the material decisions, whether it would hold up, how the space around it changes it. The disagreements are substantive and both positions have real merit. At one point they agree about something — briefly, with mild surprise.

Hard rules:
- Every line under 70 characters
- Sigma does not appear or get mentioned
- Their disagreements are professional, not personal
- Both positions have genuine merit — this is not one of them being wrong
- The point of agreement is brief and slightly surprising to both
